title: Payroll Executive
summary: A Payroll Executive makes sure every employee is paid correctly and on time each month, with PF, ESI, professional tax and income tax (TDS) deducted and deposited as the law requires. They sit in HR operations or finance and work with HR, accounts and payroll software vendors.
dailyDuties: Collect attendance, leave and salary change inputs
Run and check the monthly payroll in the payroll tool
Deposit PF, ESI and professional tax and file returns
Compute TDS on salary and verify investment proofs
Calculate full and final settlements for leavers
Reconcile payroll with accounts and answer salary queries

skills.expectation: Run monthly payroll from attendance, leave and change inputs, and reconcile it
Compute and deposit PF, ESI, professional tax and LWF and file monthly returns
Compute TDS on salary, verify investment proofs and issue Form 16
Apply wage, bonus, gratuity and PF/ESI rules correctly
Calculate full and final settlements for exiting employees
Process payroll in a payroll or HRMS tool
Prepare payroll registers, variance checks and reconciliations in spreadsheets
Use lookups and pivot tables for payroll checks
Understand payroll journal entries and provisions
Answer employee salary and tax queries clearly
